controlledWriteFacts: apply creates a new revision with exact expectedVersion and keeps all old journal/revisions.
A current OWNER_CONFIRMED cannot be downgraded or have data modified by current controlled writer; explicit later conflict uses a separate object.

New fact/relation/assessment requires origins or evidence; subject/from/to references alone are not the writer boundReference exception. New owner-adoption must therefore supply exact permitted provenance/evidence.

Retirement uses a new same-object assessment revision with disposition retired; current reader excludes retired competitors when active replacement exists. If every native competitor is retired with no active replacement, reader falls back to the retired pool and marks unusable.

Reader validity still checks pending requests and stale supports. Individual resolve retain closes exact requests but does not rewrite an old supports version; newly revised usable assessments need explicitly deliberate current supports.

Pedigree still independently requires identityGate passed for parent persons and accepted current parent edges, roles and referenced identities. OWNER_CONFIRMED alone does not currently bypass those checks.

No API/schema/code change is selected here; native reviewed outcomes plus retirement are mechanically available, whereas any generic future owner policy reader change requires exact Astra-approved scope and tests.
scopeOwnership: T0800 six-review conflict consolidation overlaps T0804; retain full previous AC/checkpoint and await root/Astra exact scope allocation, no automatic DONE.
